_comment: Local shop catalogue served by /shop/get. The archived catalogue (item ids, prices) lived on mope.io's servers and is not recoverable, so this starts empty. Item fields below are the ones the 2025 client reads (phase4/README.md). currencyType: 0 = coins, 1 = gems (others cannot be bought locally).

_item_schema.id: string - unique item id (stored in purchases)
